data_description.api_key: Create one at resend.com/api-keys. Sending access is enough.
data_description.from_address: Must use a domain you verified in Resend. A display name works too, e.g. Home Assistant <ha@example.com>.
data_description.recipient: Where the notify entity sends to. The send_email action can override this.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Resend API.

abort.already_configured: That sender address is already set up.

no_account.message: No Resend account is set up. Add the Resend integration first.

unknown_account.message: Config entry {entry_id} is not a loaded Resend account.

send_email.name: Send email
send_email.description: Sends an email through Resend, optionally rendering a Resend template.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which Resend account to send from. Defaults to the only one set up.

subject.name: Subject
subject.description: Subject line. Optional when the template defines one; overrides it when set.

template_id.name: Template ID
template_id.description: ID or alias of a published Resend template. Cannot be combined with HTML or text.

template_variables.name: Template variables
template_variables.description: Values substituted into the template. Keys allow letters, numbers and underscores. FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, EMAIL and UNSUBSCRIBE_URL are reserved by Resend.

html.name: HTML body
html.description: HTML body, for when you are not using a template.

text.name: Text body
text.description: Plain-text body. Derived from the HTML when omitted.

from_address.name: From
from_address.description: Overrides the sender configured on the account.

scheduled_at.name: Scheduled at
scheduled_at.description: Delay delivery. Accepts natural language such as 'in 1 hour' or an ISO 8601 timestamp.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: List of name/value pairs recorded against the send in Resend.

attachments.name: Attachments
attachments.description: List of attachments. Each needs a filename plus either base64 content or a publicly reachable path URL. 40 MB total.
